tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: Public Tradies directory, newest first. Only active tradie profiles; filter by trade and broad service area, with keyset pagination. No personal data beyond the tradie's chosen display name and public service area.
tools.sql: SELECT id, owner_id, owner_name, status, title, description, category, location, lat, lng, images, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE status = 'active' AND (:category IS NULL OR category = :category) AND (:location IS NULL OR lower(location) LIKE '%' || lower(:location) || '%') AND (:before IS NULL OR created_at < :before) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 24

before.description: created_at of the last row on the previous page (keyset cursor)

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Public search over active tradie profiles by title, description or service area (substring match, case-insensitive). Same privacy-safe columns as list_listings.
tools.sql: SELECT id, owner_id, owner_name, status, title, description, category, location, lat, lng, images, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE status = 'active' AND (title LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR description LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR location LIKE '%' || :q || '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Public tradie profile detail. Only active profiles are visible to the public; an archived or paused profile returns no row.
tools.sql: SELECT id, owner_id, owner_name, status, title, description, category, location, lat, lng, images, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE id = :id AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Public reviews of a listing, newest first. Exposes the reviewer's display name, never their id.
tools.sql: SELECT id, listing_id, author_name, rating, comment, created_at FROM reviews WHERE listing_id = :listing_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: listing_stats
tools.description: Public rating summary for a listing: review count and average rating.
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews WHERE listing_id = :listing_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: The caller's own listings in every status, newest first.
tools.sql: SELECT id, owner_id, owner_name, status, title, description, category, location, lat, lng, images, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE owner_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: get_my_listing
tools.description: One of the caller's own listings, in any status (for the edit form).
tools.sql: SELECT id, owner_id, owner_name, status, title, description, category, location, lat, lng, images, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Publish a public tradie profile owned by the caller. Trade, broad service area and description are required. Only a caller who selected the tradie role may create one. Idempotent under retry: the client supplies the id and a repeat is ignored (meta.changes = 0).
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO listings (id, owner_id, owner_name, status, title, description, category, location, lat, lng, images, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, :owner_name, 'active', :title, :description, :category, :location, :lat, :lng, :images, :__now, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'tradie') AND length(trim(:title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :category IN ('plumber', 'electrician', 'carpenter', 'painter', 'landscaper', 'builder', 'cleaner', 'other') AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:owner_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

owner_name.description: Display name shown on the listing

images.description: JSON array of public image keys

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Edit one of the caller's own tradie profiles. Trade, broad service area and description remain required.
tools.sql: UPDATE listings SET title = :title, description = :description, category = :category, location = :location, lat = :lat, lng = :lng, images = :images, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'tradie') AND length(trim(:title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :category IN ('plumber', 'electrician', 'carpenter', 'painter', 'landscaper', 'builder', 'cleaner', 'other') AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

images.description: JSON array of public image keys

tools.name: set_listing_status
tools.description: Pause, re-activate or archive one of the caller's own tradie profiles. Archiving is the soft delete: enquiry and message history stays intact. The transition applies only from the status the client last saw.
tools.sql: UPDATE listings SET status = :status, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id AND status = :from AND :status IN ('active', 'paused', 'archived')

from.description: Current status the caller last saw

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.description: Save an active listing to the caller's favourites (idempotent).
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO favorites (user_id, listing_id, created_at) SELECT :__user_id, :listing_id, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listings l WHERE l.id = :listing_id AND l.status = 'active')

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove a listing from the caller's favourites.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND listing_id = :listing_id

tools.name: list_my_favorites
tools.description: The caller's saved listings that are still active, most recently saved first.
tools.sql: SELECT l.id, l.owner_id, l.owner_name, l.status, l.title, l.description, l.category, l.location, l.lat, l.lng, l.images, l.created_at, l.updated_at FROM favorites f JOIN listings l ON l.id = f.listing_id WHERE f.user_id = :__user_id AND l.status = 'active' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: list_my_favorite_ids
tools.description: Ids of everything the caller has saved (to mark cards in the catalogue).
tools.sql: SELECT listing_id FROM favorites WHERE user_id = :__user_id LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Send a private direct enquiry to a tradie profile; it does not create a public job. Refused silently (meta.changes = 0) when: the profile is not active, roles are not customer-to-tradie, the caller owns it, either side has blocked the other, the message is invalid, or the caller already has an open enquiry on it. Idempotent under retry by client id.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO requests (id, listing_id, requester_id, requester_name, status, note, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :listing_id, :__user_id, :requester_name, 'pending', :note, :__now, :__now FROM listings l WHERE l.id = :listing_id AND l.status = 'active' AND l.owner_id != :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles customer WHERE customer.user_id = :__user_id AND customer.role = 'customer') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles tradie WHERE tradie.user_id = l.owner_id AND tradie.role = 'tradie') AND length(trim(:requester_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:note)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = l.owner_id) OR (b.blocker_id = l.owner_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM requests r WHERE r.listing_id = :listing_id AND r.requester_id = :__user_id AND r.status IN ('pending', 'accepted'))

requester_name.description: Display name shown to the owner

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description: Requests the caller has made, with the listing title, newest first.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id, r.listing_id, r.requester_id, r.status, r.note, r.created_at, r.updated_at, l.title AS listing_title, l.owner_id, l.owner_name FROM requests r JOIN listings l ON l.id = r.listing_id WHERE r.requester_id = :__user_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Withdraw one of the caller's own open enquiries using the status the caller last saw.
tools.sql: UPDATE requests SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND requester_id = :__user_id AND status = :from AND :from IN ('pending', 'accepted')

from.description: Current status the caller last saw

tools.name: list_incoming_requests
tools.description: Private direct enquiries received by the caller as a tradie, newest first. Only their own profiles' enquiries are returned.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id, r.listing_id, r.requester_id, r.requester_name, r.status, r.note, r.created_at, r.updated_at, l.title AS listing_title FROM requests r JOIN listings l ON l.id = r.listing_id WHERE l.owner_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'tradie') ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: set_request_status
tools.description: Owner moves a request along its lifecycle. Guarded transition: only applies when the request is currently in `from` (pending → accepted | declined; accepted → completed | declined). A stale client sees meta.changes = 0.
tools.sql: UPDATE requests SET status = :to, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND status = :from AND ((:from = 'pending' AND :to IN ('accepted', 'declined')) OR (:from = 'accepted' AND :to IN ('completed', 'declined'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listings l WHERE l.id = requests.listing_id AND l.owner_id = :__user_id)

from.description: Current status the caller last saw

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a private message after a direct enquiry. Threads only run between that enquiry's customer and tradie; blocks are enforced here as well as on enquiries.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO messages (id, listing_id, sender_id, sender_name, recipient_id, body, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :listing_id, :__user_id, :sender_name, :recipient_id, :body, :__now WHERE :recipient_id != :__user_id AND length(trim(:sender_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:body)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM requests r JOIN listings l ON l.id = r.listing_id WHERE r.listing_id = :listing_id AND ((r.requester_id = :__user_id AND l.owner_id = :recipient_id) OR (l.owner_id = :__user_id AND r.requester_id = :recipient_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = :recipient_id) OR (b.blocker_id = :recipient_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id))

sender_name.description: Display name shown to the recipient

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: The thread between the caller and one other person about a listing, oldest first. Only the two parties can read it.
tools.sql: SELECT id, listing_id, sender_id, sender_name, recipient_id, body, created_at FROM messages WHERE listing_id = :listing_id AND ((sender_id = :__user_id AND recipient_id = :other_id) OR (sender_id = :other_id AND recipient_id = :__user_id)) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 500

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: The caller's threads, most recent activity first: listing, the other party, last message time.
tools.sql: SELECT m.listing_id, l.title AS listing_title, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = :__user_id THEN m.recipient_id ELSE m.sender_id END AS other_id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.sender_id != :__user_id THEN m.sender_name END), l.owner_name) AS other_name, MAX(m.created_at) AS last_at FROM messages m JOIN listings l ON l.id = m.listing_id WHERE m.sender_id = :__user_id OR m.recipient_id = :__user_id GROUP BY m.listing_id, other_id ORDER BY last_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: can_review
tools.description: Requests the caller completed on a listing that have no review yet — the only thing a review can attach to.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id AS request_id FROM requests r WHERE r.listing_id = :listing_id AND r.requester_id = :__user_id AND r.status = 'completed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews v WHERE v.request_id = r.id) LIMIT 10

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Review a listing after a completed request. One review per request (a repeat is ignored); refused unless the request is the caller's and completed.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reviews (id, listing_id, request_id, author_id, author_name, rating, comment, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, r.listing_id, r.id, :__user_id, :author_name, :rating, :comment, :__now FROM requests r WHERE r.id = :request_id AND r.requester_id = :__user_id AND r.status = 'completed' AND :rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5

author_name.description: Display name shown on the review

tools.name: block_user
tools.description: Block another user: they can no longer message the caller or request the caller's listings (and vice versa). Idempotent.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO blocks (blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at) SELECT :__user_id, :blocked_id, :__now WHERE :blocked_id != :__user_id

tools.name: unblock_user
tools.description: Remove a block the caller placed.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM blocks WHERE blocker_id = :__user_id AND blocked_id = :blocked_id

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: User ids the caller has blocked.
tools.sql: SELECT blocked_id, created_at FROM blocks WHERE blocker_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: The caller's immutable Tradies role and, for a tradie, their selected trade category.
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, role, trade_category FROM profiles WHERE user_id = :__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_profile
tools.description: Choose the caller's Tradies role once. A repeat is ignored, so setup retries are idempotent. Tradies must select a trade category.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO profiles (user_id, role, trade_category, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :__user_id, :role, CASE WHEN :role = 'tradie' THEN :trade_category ELSE '' END, :__now, :__now WHERE :role IN ('customer', 'tradie') AND (:role = 'customer' OR length(trim(:trade_category)) > 0)

trade_category.description: Primary trade for a tradie; blank for a customer

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Public job board, newest open jobs first. It exposes only the work summary, trade and broad service area — never a customer id, name, precise address, contact details or private participant data.
tools.sql: SELECT id, lifecycle, title, description, category, location, created_at, updated_at FROM jobs WHERE status = 'open' AND lifecycle = 'open' AND (:category IS NULL OR category = :category) AND (:location IS NULL OR lower(location) LIKE '%' || lower(:location) || '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

location.description: Filter by broad service area substring

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Public detail for one open job. Only privacy-safe lead fields are returned; drafts and closed jobs are not public.
tools.sql: SELECT id, lifecycle, title, description, category, location, created_at, updated_at FROM jobs WHERE id = :id AND status = 'open' AND lifecycle = 'open' LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_jobs
tools.description: The customer caller's own jobs in every lifecycle, newest first. Private address and contact details remain on the single-job owner action.
tools.sql: SELECT id, lifecycle, title, description, category, location, created_at, updated_at FROM jobs WHERE customer_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'customer') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: get_my_job
tools.description: The customer owner's complete job, including the precise address and contact details they supplied. No other caller can read it.
tools.sql: SELECT id, lifecycle, title, description, category, location, private_address, contact_details, created_at, updated_at FROM jobs WHERE id = :id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'customer') LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Create a customer-owned draft or open job. The client supplies the id and retries are ignored. Precise address and contact details are stored only for the owner; public job actions never select them.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO jobs (id, customer_id, status, title, description, category, location, private_address, contact_details, lifecycle, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, CASE WHEN :lifecycle = 'open' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END, :title, :description, :category, :location, :private_address, :contact_details, :lifecycle, :__now, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'customer') AND length(trim(:title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :category IN ('plumber', 'electrician', 'carpenter', 'painter', 'landscaper', 'builder', 'cleaner', 'other') AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:private_address)) <= 500 AND length(trim(:contact_details)) <= 500 AND :lifecycle IN ('draft', 'open')

description.description: Public job description without contact details

private_address.description: Precise address, visible only to the customer owner and future authorised job participants

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Update a customer-owned draft or open job, including owner-private detail. Closed jobs must be re-opened before editing. Ownership, role and validation are enforced in SQL.
tools.sql: UPDATE jobs SET title = :title, description = :description, category = :category, location = :location, private_address = :private_address, contact_details = :contact_details, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND lifecycle IN ('draft', 'open') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'customer') AND length(trim(:title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :category IN ('plumber', 'electrician', 'carpenter', 'painter', 'landscaper', 'builder', 'cleaner', 'other') AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(trim(:private_address)) <= 500 AND length(trim(:contact_details)) <= 500

tools.name: set_job_status
tools.description: Move a customer-owned job through draft → open → closed, or re-open closed work, using the lifecycle the caller last saw. A stale or unauthorised transition changes nothing.
tools.sql: UPDATE jobs SET lifecycle = :to, status = CASE WHEN :to = 'open' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND lifecycle = :from AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'customer') AND ((:from = 'draft' AND :to = 'open') OR (:from = 'open' AND :to = 'closed') OR (:from = 'closed' AND :to = 'open'))

from.description: Current lifecycle the caller last saw

tools.name: create_job_quote
tools.description: Submit one private, informational quote for an open customer job. The quote belongs to its tradie and is visible only to that tradie and the job's customer; it never initiates payment or checkout. A client id makes retries safe.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO quotes (id, target_type, target_id, customer_id, tradie_id, status, scope, amount, currency, timing, valid_until, notes, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, 'job', j.id, j.customer_id, :__user_id, 'submitted', :scope, :amount, :currency, :timing, :valid_until, :notes, :__now, :__now FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.status = 'open' AND j.lifecycle = 'open' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'tradie') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = j.customer_id) OR (b.blocker_id = j.customer_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id)) AND length(trim(:scope)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :amount >= 0 AND :amount <= 100000000 AND :currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' AND length(trim(:timing)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:notes)) <= 2000 AND (:valid_until IS NULL OR :valid_until > :__now)

amount.description: Informational amount only; not a payment instruction

valid_until.description: Optional quote expiry timestamp in milliseconds

tools.name: create_request_quote
tools.description: Submit one private, informational quote in response to a direct enquiry. Only the enquiry's tradie may create it; only that tradie and customer may read it.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO quotes (id, target_type, target_id, customer_id, tradie_id, status, scope, amount, currency, timing, valid_until, notes, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, 'request', r.id, r.requester_id, :__user_id, 'submitted', :scope, :amount, :currency, :timing, :valid_until, :notes, :__now, :__now FROM requests r JOIN listings l ON l.id = r.listing_id WHERE r.id = :request_id AND l.owner_id = :__user_id AND r.status IN ('pending', 'accepted') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'tradie') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = :__user_id AND b.blocked_id = r.requester_id) OR (b.blocker_id = r.requester_id AND b.blocked_id = :__user_id)) AND length(trim(:scope)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :amount >= 0 AND :amount <= 100000000 AND :currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' AND length(trim(:timing)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:notes)) <= 2000 AND (:valid_until IS NULL OR :valid_until > :__now)

amount.description: Informational amount only; not a payment instruction

valid_until.description: Optional quote expiry timestamp in milliseconds

tools.name: list_job_quotes
tools.description: Compare private quotes for one of the caller's jobs. A customer never sees another customer's quotes, and tradies cannot use this action to inspect rivals.
tools.sql: SELECT id, target_type, target_id, status, scope, amount, currency, timing, valid_until, notes, revision, created_at, updated_at, accepted_at FROM quotes WHERE target_type = 'job' AND target_id = :job_id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.customer_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'accepted' THEN 0 WHEN 'submitted' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, amount ASC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_request_quotes
tools.description: Compare private quotes for one of the caller's direct enquiries. A customer never sees another customer's quotes, and tradies cannot use this action to inspect rivals.
tools.sql: SELECT id, target_type, target_id, status, scope, amount, currency, timing, valid_until, notes, revision, created_at, updated_at, accepted_at FROM quotes WHERE target_type = 'request' AND target_id = :request_id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM requests r WHERE r.id = :request_id AND r.requester_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'accepted' THEN 0 WHEN 'submitted' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, amount ASC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_my_quotes
tools.description: A tradie's own private quotes only, newest first. This action does not disclose customer details or competing quotes.
tools.sql: SELECT id, target_type, target_id, status, scope, amount, currency, timing, valid_until, notes, revision, created_at, updated_at, accepted_at FROM quotes WHERE tradie_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND p.role = 'tradie') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: revise_quote
tools.description: Revise the caller's submitted quote. Revision is guarded by the current status and replaces the informational terms atomically; it cannot change the customer, tradie, or target.
tools.sql: UPDATE quotes SET scope = :scope, amount = :amount, currency = :currency, timing = :timing, valid_until = :valid_until, notes = :notes, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND tradie_id = :__user_id AND status = 'submitted' AND length(trim(:scope)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND :amount >= 0 AND :amount <= 100000000 AND :currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' AND length(trim(:timing)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:notes)) <= 2000 AND (:valid_until IS NULL OR :valid_until > :__now)

valid_until.description: Optional quote expiry timestamp in milliseconds

tools.name: withdraw_quote
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's currently submitted quote. Accepted, declined, expired and already-withdrawn quotes cannot be moved by this action.
tools.sql: UPDATE quotes SET status = 'withdrawn', updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND tradie_id = :__user_id AND status = :from AND :from = 'submitted' AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > :__now)

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Customer selects one currently valid submitted quote. The atomic no-accepted-quote guard makes simultaneous or stale selection attempts safe; amounts remain informational and payment is arranged outside Tradies.
tools.sql: UPDATE quotes SET status = 'accepted', accepted_at = :__now, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND status = :from AND :from = 'submitted' AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > :__now) AND ((target_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = quotes.target_id AND j.customer_id = :__user_id)) OR (target_type = 'request' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM requests r WHERE r.id = quotes.target_id AND r.requester_id = :__user_id AND r.status IN ('pending', 'accepted')))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quotes selected WHERE selected.target_type = quotes.target_type AND selected.target_id = quotes.target_id AND selected.status = 'accepted')

tools.name: decline_quote
tools.description: Customer declines one submitted quote on their own job or direct enquiry. A stale, expired, withdrawn, accepted, or unauthorised quote changes nothing.
tools.sql: UPDATE quotes SET status = 'declined', updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND customer_id = :__user_id AND status = :from AND :from = 'submitted' AND ((target_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = quotes.target_id AND j.customer_id = :__user_id)) OR (target_type = 'request' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM requests r WHERE r.id = quotes.target_id AND r.requester_id = :__user_id)))

tools.name: report_user
tools.description: Report another user, optionally about a specific listing. Reports are reviewed by the app owner (read with the platform's owner tooling, never exposed in-app).
tools.sql: INSERT INTO reports (id, reporter_id, reported_id, listing_id, reason, note, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, :__user_id, :reported_id, :listing_id, :reason, :note, :__now WHERE :reported_id != :__user_id
